name: Ram (son of Jerahmeel)
title: Firstborn in the line of Jerahmeel
summary: Ram was the firstborn son of Jerahmeel in the tribe of Judah. He is mentioned in the genealogy in Chronicles as the father of Maaz, Jamin and Eker.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jerahmeel
keyEvents.description: Ram is listed as the firstborn of Jerahmeel in the genealogy of Judah.
